unit: GRID3 settlement extent (v4.1 blocks merged by mgrs_code)

buildings.label: Buildings
buildings.licence: Open with attribution (GRID3 terms; confirm exact licence)
buildings.method: Sum of building_count over the settlement's blocks.
limitations: Rows are settlement BLOCKS, not settlements; blocks are aggregated into settlement extents by build.mjs.
Derived from building-footprint models; small or new settlements may be missing.
No settlement names; names come only from GRID3 named settlement points.

builtAreaM2.label: Built-up roof area
builtAreaM2.licence: Open with attribution (GRID3 terms; confirm exact licence)
limitations: Rows are settlement BLOCKS, not settlements; blocks are aggregated into settlement extents by build.mjs.
Derived from building-footprint models; small or new settlements may be missing.
No settlement names; names come only from GRID3 named settlement points.

areaHa.label: Settlement extent area
areaHa.licence: Open with attribution (GRID3 terms; confirm exact licence)
areaHa.method: Geodesic area of the merged block polygons.

pop.label: Population (2026 estimate)
pop.method: Sum of WorldPop 100 m cells whose centre lies inside the settlement extent.
limitations: Modelled estimate, not a census count.
100 m cells are assigned to a settlement by cell centre; edge cells may fall to neighbours.
Hamlets smaller than one cell may show 0.

hrea.label: Night-light electrification likelihood (2020)
hrea.provider: University of Michigan HREA v1.1 (from VIIRS night lights)
hrea.method: Mean of valid HREA set_prplit cells inside the extent; else the cell at the representative point; else Unknown.
limitations: Modelled likelihood that a settlement is lit at night, as of 2020.
Low values do NOT prove a settlement has no electricity (small loads, solar home systems and intermittent supply are often invisible).
Cells with no value are reported as unknown, not as zero.

dHealth.label: Distance to nearest health facility
dHealth.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer.
limitations: 'functional' flag is reported, not field-verified.
Electricity status of facilities is not recorded.

nHealth2km.label: Health facilities within 2 km
nHealth2km.method: Count within 2 km of the representative point.
limitations: 'functional' flag is reported, not field-verified.
Electricity status of facilities is not recorded.

dSchool.label: Distance to nearest school
dSchool.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer.
limitations: Older dataset; closures and new schools since collection are not reflected.

nSchool2km.label: Schools within 2 km
nSchool2km.method: Count within 2 km of the representative point.
limitations: Older dataset; closures and new schools since collection are not reflected.

dMarket.label: Distance to nearest recorded market
dMarket.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer.
limitations: Very few markets recorded in the pilot area; absence is not evidence of no market.

dRoad.label: Distance to nearest trunk–tertiary road
dRoad.provider: GRID3 Nigeria (built from Overture/OSM and Meta data)
dRoad.licence: Open with attribution (GRID3 terms; underlying ODbL for OSM-derived segments)
dRoad.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer.
limitations: Only trunk–tertiary classes are fetched; residential roads and tracks are excluded.
Road condition is not recorded.

dMv.label: Distance to nearest mapped 33/11 kV line
dMv.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer. SE4ALL MV lines plus OSM lines tagged below 66 kV.
limitations: Licence not stated: internal use only until SE4ALL/REA confirms permission.
Utility-reported network; completeness and energisation are unknown.
A line nearby does NOT mean a settlement is connected; no line nearby does NOT mean it is unelectrified.

dHv.label: Distance to nearest mapped HV line
dHv.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer. SE4ALL HV lines plus OSM lines tagged ≥ 66 kV.
limitations: Licence not stated: internal use only.
Transmission lines do not supply settlements directly.

dSub.label: Distance to nearest mapped substation
dSub.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer. SE4ALL plus OSM substations.
limitations: Licence not stated: internal use only.

dMg.label: Distance to nearest recorded mini-grid
dMg.method: Planar distance (km) from the settlement's representative point to the nearest feature inside the three LGAs plus a 10 km buffer.
limitations: Licence not stated: internal use only.
Operational status as reported; may be outdated.

checks.title: Ward boundaries (2026) vs LGA boundaries (2019)
checks.detail: Lowest mutual area overlap: 84.2 %. Wards whose interior point falls in a different LGA: Adavi-Eba.

checks.title: GRID3 v4.1 rows are blocks and are aggregated into settlements
checks.detail: 21109 blocks in the download window form 5435 mgrs_code groups; 5319 (97.9 %) have exactly blocks_per_settl_extent blocks and one extent_type. 1516 settlements fall inside the three LGAs.

checks.title: Block-count mismatches inside the pilot LGAs
checks.detail: 41 settlements (2.70 %) have a block count different from blocks_per_settl_extent. They are kept and flagged 'block_count_mismatch'.

checks.title: Aggregated settlements are contiguous
checks.detail: 6 settlements (0.40 %) are multipart after merging their blocks (flag 'multipart').

checks.title: Settlements crossing LGA boundaries (clipped at block level)
checks.detail: 20 settlement parts come from GRID3 extents that straddle an LGA boundary (flag 'split_by_lga_boundary'). Each block is assigned to the LGA containing it; blocks outside the three LGAs are dropped, so cross-boundary towns (e.g. the Okene conurbation) only contribute the part inside the pilot LGAs.

checks.title: Settlement ward assignment
checks.detail: 84 settlements fall outside every ward polygon (flag 'outside_ward_boundaries'); 0 fall in a ward whose LGA differs from the LGA polygon (flag 'ward_lga_conflict'). Caused by the 2019 LGA vs 2026 ward boundary mismatch.

checks.title: Settlement names
checks.detail: 592 GRID3 named points lie inside the LGAs: 577 fall inside a settlement extent, 8 within 150 m of one, 7 match no extent (left unused). 378 settlements (24.9 %) received a single name; 19 large extents contain more than 3 named places and list them instead of taking one name; the rest are labelled 'Unnamed settlement'.

checks.title: Population captured by settlement extents
checks.detail: 1,077,879 of 1,225,231 modelled residents (88.0 %) fall in settlement extents. 13 settlements (mostly small hamlets narrower than one 100 m cell) receive 0 because no cell centre falls inside them.

checks.title: HREA electrification likelihood coverage
checks.detail: 734 settlements have an HREA value; 782 (51.6 %) fall outside HREA's settlement mask and are Unknown (not 0).

checks.title: Distance indicators
checks.detail: Measured from each settlement's representative point to infrastructure inside the LGAs plus a 10 km buffer (edge-effect correction). Index sizes: health 849, school 998, market 19, road 2492, mv 506, hv 23, sub 11, mg 0.

checks.title: Sample data isolation
checks.detail: Pipeline scripts import app code (lib/, seed, store): no. Output settlements carrying a sample marker: 0. The map loads only /api/geo/* layers built from data/raw/.

flags.block_count_mismatch: Number of blocks differs from GRID3's blocks_per_settl_extent.
flags.split_by_lga_boundary: The GRID3 extent straddles an LGA boundary; only the blocks inside this LGA are included.
flags.outside_ward_boundaries: Representative point is not inside any 2026 ward polygon.
flags.ward_lga_conflict: Containing ward belongs to a different LGA than the LGA polygon.
flags.multipart: Merged blocks form more than one polygon.
